rule.description: A named type whose inherent fn definitions, summed across all of its inherent impl blocks in the crate, reach the configured budget (20) has accumulated more responsibility than one type should own.

checks.description: Aggregates every inherent fn a type defines across all of its impl blocks in the crate and reports the type once when the aggregate reaches the budget of 20.
checks.detected_relation: one named type -> absorbed multi-domain inherent method surface (state machine, queue policy, expiry ordering, file-ID scanning, factory wiring, clock provisioning)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The reported type concentrates the whole debouncing pipeline - pending-state mutation, rename stitching, rescan serialization, expiry scheduling, file-ID scanning, component wiring and clock provisioning - which previously lived across distinct owners (a state record with its own method set, a queue policy owner, sorting and clock free functions, a component factory, and scan internals owned by the file-ID cache).

matches.evidence: type `Debouncer` accumulates 33 inherent method definitions across 2 impl block(s) at notify-debouncer-full/src/lib.rs:247 (budget 20); owned functions: new_opt, stop, stop_nonblocking, set_stop, watcher, cache, add_root, remove_root, watch, unwatch, watched_paths, update_paths, configure, kind, dispatch_event, push_error, take_errors, handle_rename_from, handle_rename_to, push_rename_event, push_remove_event, push_event, queue_was_created, queue_was_removed, recursive_mode_for, expire_events, sorted_events, now, cached_file_id_of, scan_file_ids, forget_file_ids, rescan_file_ids, dir_scan_depth

excluded.reason: Trait implementations are interface obligations and are never counted; only inherent impl blocks belong to the rule.
cfg(test) harness code is not part of the default check targets the analysis runs, so it is outside the measurement.

excluded.location: notify (EventLoop, Config, Event, Error, PollWatcher), notify-debouncer-mini (Debouncer, DebounceDataInner)
excluded.reason: Other workspace crates are measured by the same rule under the same budget, but their maximum aggregate (16 inherent functions) stays below the budget, so they produce no match in any state.
